dedupe_keys.name: a holistic framework for site specific wind power forecasting

description: Vukobrat, Antonina and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The application combines numerical weather predictions, on-site measurements, wake modelling and neural networks to forecast wind speed, direction, density and temperature 36 hours ahead. A static bat-protection shutdown strategy is included in power estimation. The source evaluates an onshore farm against site measurements and reports the strongest atmospheric forecasts from convolutional neural networks. This is a site-specific operational forecast assessment, with exact site identity and measurement availability unstated; it is not an electricity-demand forecast. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The forecasting method is based on the combination of weather predictions with site observations.
